title: Your first core
lead: Create a core, append blocks, read one back, and stream them all. Start here.
expect:
length: 3
block 0: Hello, Hypercore!
streamed: Hello, Hypercore!
streamed: second block
streamed: third block

title: Replicate, and download only one block
lead: A writer holds five blocks. A reader that knows only the writer's public key asks for block 3, and receives just that block.
expect:
downloaded block 3
reader got: block 3
reader has block 3? true
reader has block 0? false
reader length: 5

title: Snapshot a core, then truncate it
lead: A snapshot keeps a read-only view while the core grows. Truncating shortens the core and starts a new fork.
expect:
core length: 4 snapshot length: 3
fork before: 0
length after truncate: 2 fork after: 1

title: Encrypt blocks on disk
lead: Pass an encryption key and blocks are stored encrypted. Reads decrypt them with the same key.
